title: DOT’s 26-State Electric and Autonomous Aircraft Trials Officially Begin
summary: The FAA and U.S. Transportation Department’s (DOT) highly anticipated trials of precertified electric air taxis, autonomous cargo drones, and other novel aviation technologies—expected to span at least three years and 26 states—are officially underway.
